responseMessageContents.text:
The export feature is still there! The PDF export button (the `FileDown` icon) is present in the profile page at line 297-304. It appears in the header next to the share button when you have at least one summit recorded (`summitCount > 0`).

If you're not seeing it, it's likely because you haven't logged any summits yet — the export and share buttons only show when `summitCount > 0`. Try marking a mountain as summited first, then the buttons should appear in the top-right corner of the Profile tab.
